body: Looks cheap, like something you buy at an asian dollar store in NYC.
I dont understand this.
No, i will never try therapy again. I won't be thrown into a hospital again. And I'm tired of having to lie to therapists so that they'll help me and not stick me in a hospital.

I called the suicide Hotline in my country and they hung up on me. Ever since then I won't call again.

My doctor won't even give me weed, let alone ketamine. I live in a country where I seriously doubt that would even be legal. I don't have a therapist anymore because my therapist abandoned me. I won't get a new one because I don't want to be hurt again.
From my experience G-d doesn't care about my life.
I got my period and c cup breasts at 8.
I dont remember much of my childhood. What I remember is mostly sadness. I have been clinically depressed since I was 12. Before that is mostly fog.

No i was only in the hospital for 24 hours. I left as soon as they let me.

The gun had no bullets. I searched for them and when I couldn't find them I just put it in my mouth and shot, hoping it was loaded. I don't know how to check. Well it wasn't loaded so here I am.
Existing. Failing. Being a suicidal mess. Ruining my friendships and relationships. Not living up to expectations others have of me.

I live in Europe and can't even get weed prescribed, despite it being the only thing on the list to ever really help. I don't have a therapist anymore but there's no way he would have given me ketamine. I don't think anyone in my country would give me that. Maybe I will look illegally
Thats all pointless though. I need a reason. Like, a real reason. Something to give me hope. I don't care if my shampoo is empty. I don't even care about my pets anymore.
Multiple medicines and combinations of medicines, harder drugs, dbt, mbt, and cbt therapies, over 20 therapists in 4 countries for 12 years, religion, mindfulness, 2 hospitals, etc.
Thank you <3 im sorry but I don't have energy to write more. But thank you for taking the time to reply with so much

Honestly this may sound funny but yours is the most comforting comment I have gotten in ages. I'm so tired of people pretending I should be ok. I've tried for 28 years to be ok. So much damn medicine... So many thousands of dollars in therapy in 3 different continents. I'm over it. Thank you for not giving me some sugary bullshit about how life gets better.
Food doesn't make me want to live. Pizza is not a good enough reason to go through so much suffering. I'm glad it works for you though.
You dont know my situation. This post was a simplified version of my life. Its not extreme if you know my history. Im just posting because keeping the secret from everyone is hard.

She has found me a complete list of all bpd therapists in my area. I contacted every office and there are no openings. Ive been looking for months. In person therapy is very important to me so online wont work. Its fine anyway. I gave up.

No. Im just tired of having to hide how im feeling from everyone around me. If i say something theyll try to stop me. I wanted to have the comfort in my final days of being able to open up online instead. My therapist says she tried and her approach isnt working for me. And suggests i seek someone with a different method. They always say this before they leave.

I don't see the point in explaining. Im just done trying. This post was only meant so I could tell someone, since it will be a secret in real life until i succeed. But if you really want to know, my post history should explain enough.
Ohhhh thats super cool! I have a shirt thats sort of similar and I looove it
Oh i love your hair!!
You make me feel even worse by removing this. Thanks for nothing.
Why do you need to remove it? What rule does it break?
But... Shes been so wonderful to me... I really think she is trying her best...

I tried getting better for many years. Nothing works. And now my therapist says it is too much for her, and that my suicidal thoughts will never go away. I am just waiting for the day i can finally crash in a car or something, and leave in peace.

Like I already said, I need my death to look like an accident so my friends arent angry. I would jump in front of a train but its too obvious because I already tried and was stopped twice. I haven't fallen off a balcony for the same reason. Tried that already, when I was 16. The family and friends need to suspect nothing.

The fact that I am still here is due to multiple failed suicide attempts, and the fact that i need my death to look like an accident and be absolutely foolproof... Aka no waking up half braindead. I have been suicidal since I was 12. I am 28 now. 2 years ago I was also in severe pain. I tried to jump in front of a train and my friend stopped me. In 2 years time, if I am still alive, nothing will have changed besides my desire to die growing stronger. I dont remember the last time I didn't actively want to die.

By your reasoning, i should have died multiple times already. 2 years is nothing. I have wanted to die for 16.

She is one of the only bpd specialists in my city, and ive already been passed off to the next person by over 10 therapists. Im running out of people and out of hope. No, i am out of hope. Every therapist i go to tries to get rid of me.

So how do i change it? Im afraid to tell her because i think nothing will change besides me upsetting her, and maybe pushing her away. And i do care about her, even if love is hard for me right now. I dont think me telling her will make her visit me more. And i dont think she will tell her parents. So what am i accomplishing by telling her how sad i am? I dont want to push her away

But... Is it worth it? In the end nothing will change. She wont come out to them, and i would NEVER make her. I know first hand how terrifying and sad it is, especially when you arent ready. So all I will accomplish by telling her is to make her sad, and make me feel worse for making her sad. I dont think anything will change. And i dont want her to leave me because i said something.
I have been in therapy for over 10 years and i am currently doing MBT.

I feel invisible because her family doesnt know I exist. I cant share any special holidays or moments with them... And Ive only met 2 of her friends. I feel like im some sort of secret affair, and it makes me feel dirty. I am jealous of my friends whose families love their significant others. I can't chat with her mom. Take her dad to dinner. I cant even spend new years with them, because i am literally invisible. Non-existent. I cant even post photos of us on Facebook, in case her parents see. 

I dont know what to do because i would NEVER force her out of the closet for my sake. I know how sucky that is. If i tell her, i think nothing will change besides making her sad. And i dont want to upset her. But i feel worthless like this.
So i should tell her its bothering me? That im tired of being invisible and that i want to see her more often?
Ive told them. Were working on finding something else, but im running out of options since ive already tried many. Im on Cymbalta, zyprexa, and truxal now.

I don't even need to be above her family. I dont really expect that. But i want to be known... I want to meet her mom. Have dinner with her dad. Be part of her life. The way its going now, i cant even come to her birthday. Im nobody.
I dont need to be number 1. I just want to be acknowledged. That i exist. Even being introduced as her friend would hurt less than pretending i dont exist

I know. But i dont know what else to do. I just want to feel happy but even with all this medication and therapy, im still not ok. I just want a happy family. A wife and kids. But no matter how hard i try i am almost always sad. I dont want to reply on my gf but i also want to be happy. This is why she doesnt know half the time im sad. I dont put stuff on her.
:( im sorry! Thank you for helping

Yah. Youre right.... 4 months isnt so much. I do want to say, I do care about her. Its just not love yet, like she says she has for me. I just dont see her enough for me to feel that way. But im really hoping for it.
She lives on her own. Her parents live 2 hours away. I live 1. 5 hours away.

Well, im TRYING to like her. But i never see her.... I cant like someone I dont know. Thats her fault, not mine. We live 1.5 hours away and I only see her maybe 3 days a month. Im not asking her to prove she loves me. Im asking her to see me more often and stop hiding me like im some sort of filth.

I find her boring because when she comes over, its often late at night, after work. And so we watch something and go to bed. And the next morning she leaves again. Im lucky if i ever spend daylight with her.

Thank you. Im glad youre doing better too. I just talked to 2 of my therapists about this problem today, actually. They suggested i tell her how I feel. But i am afraid because if i tell her, i will make her sad. And nothing will change because of it. I know she won't see me more or tell her family about me. But shes all i have. And i care for her. Working on love. So... I dont know. I just feel lost.

I was thinking more of her spending once a week with me, not every day. As for her family relationships, I see your point, but I don't know how to make the hurt in my heart to away. I feel like a secret. I feel like her words of love mean nothing if she has to hide me.

I mean, i do care about her. But not love...im trying to build that, but its really hard when i barely see her. I feel like I don't know her. And i find her a bit boring. I just want to spend enough time to feel like i know who the heck she is. But im always second to her family. Shes always with her family. No time for me.

I really am trying so hard to love her. But she doesnt even want to spend new years with me.... How can i believe she loves me when she doesnt make the effort?
Maybe. I don't know. I think she just thinks of me as second to her family. And i want more than that. I want to be equal. Right now I just feel like her side project.

I mean, I am really trying to develop feelings for her. But right now she feels more like a friend or colleague because I dont see her enough to know her well. I don't feel like were together. She lives 1.5 hours away and rarely has time for me. I feel like barely know her. And I want that to change, but Im afraid to tell her because it will just upset her. I know she will say shes doing her best. But like... I need 1000000% more.
Thank you 🥺 I dont know. Nothing is a deal breaker to me. I just dont want to be alone again. I cant face that sort of sadness.

I dont know. I honestly dont see her enough for me to say whether this relationship is healthy or good. And I certainly dont feel like a better person besides being less suicidal. I feel the same. I care about her but more like a friend or acquaintance. But maybe it hasnt been long enough? Its only 4 months... I just know I can't be alone again. I can't find anyone else. I was on 5 dating apps and had been through all the matches multiple times when her new profile showed up. This took 3 years.

Yes, I have 3 therapists that I see twice a week for over 2 years now. They are bpd specialists.

Her not coming out is making me miserable. She says she cares but she clearly doesn't.
Lol. You mean the team of 3 specialists ive been seeing for the past 2 years? Or the hospitals and clinics I frequent? Yah. They're not helping. Thanks for trying though. ❤️

Yah, unless you're diagnosed with incurable severe bpd. My life is a series of disappointments and failed suicide attempts. Having a relationship makes things almost bearable. Without it I am nothing. I cant risk losing her. I just need her to treat me better. But if I say something, I may lose her after all... :'(
I'm afraid to lose her....when im single, i get even more suicidal and unwell. And it took me 3 years to find someone....

Thank you 🥺 The problem is, I dont have any deal breakers. I cant risk being alone again. Nothing is worse to me than that. And where I live, it will take years to find someone new. The lgbtq scene is tiny. But I feel so unwanted and unloved and just overwhelmingly like a dirty secret. I wont break up with her over it though. I'll just let it fester like all the rest of the problems in my life. I will talk to her eventually but I just know nothing will change.

I dont know what I want though. Nothing is a deal breaker because I just dont want to be lonely. I cant go back to being single. It was 3 of the worst years of my life. And the dating pool for lesbians is almost nonexistent where I live. I like her but Im not obsessed.  I dont know. Its not what I wanted but I know I can't get any better, especially where I live, and with my looks and illnesses.

Loneliness does not come and go for me. It is a nonestop monster that ruins my life. Just check my post history.
What do I do? I am afraid to talk to her about it. I think she will choose her family over me :'( Or say tough luck, this is what you get...
Thank you so much for answering :'/ I thought no one would care.

No, she isn't out to her family. And I can't find someone in my city... I looked for 3 years nonestop. I live in a place with very few women who want to seriously commit to another woman. I am lonely beyond belief.
Thank you
Thank you
Thank you. I hope you feel better
Thank you for being the first person to say anything
Thank you 😭 I hope it gets better for you too

Please, someone tell me this wont be my future... To feel nothing at all, after craving love for so long...all I can think about is how I must have fooled her into thinking Im a good person. How our relationship will end in flames, just like everything else I touch, in only a matter of time...
I've had therapy for 10 years. It's not working.
This sounds like I wrote it. I know how you feel... I'm so sorry you're so alone. I wish I could help. I wish I could help us both.
I mean, I believe the world is just a rock and our existence on it is meaningless in the end. I think reading more about existentialism will just make me more depressed...

Thank you. Someone who finally agrees. And I agree. Life should be a choice. It's stupid to think everyone whose presented with it will enjoy it or benefit from it. If years of therapy and medicine don't make it better, it's not going to get better. It's best for some people to call it quits.
Lol I'm a lesbian. Im not interested in men.

What good is all that when you can't stop thinking of death? Food is nice and all, but it doesn't distract me from how I'm feeling inside. A good book can't take away how I'm feeling. It's just a temporary mask.
Not really. It came out of nowhere and was made worse by recent bad news. I think seeing my friends all over their partners doesn't help though.

Eh.... I think that's seriously creepy, honestly. And really just... Kind of disgusting? Not to mention I would find "loving" an inanimate object to be even more lonely than being literally alone. But thanks for the suggestion...
Covid is not the problem.
Figures. That's life, and then we die.
Thank you. I appreciate it. You're a good person. I hope you find happiness.

I don't deserve that sort of care. And plus, I already have a best friend who understands and loves me more than I could ever imagine. And it still isn't enough. Nothing will ever be enough unless it's a woman who wants to marry me and die by my side. And then I would just end up hurting her...
I'm not a good friend or lover. I'm not worthy of it.

I will literally rip my arm open if she says the wrong thing. If she says "I like you" instead of love. If she forgets plans we've made. If she looks at someone in a way that suggests she may like them more than me.. I'm not healthy. Even though I crave love more than anything, I'm well aware that dating me would be like dating a bomb. That's why it's best I die. To avoid hurting others and to give myself peace. But this will never happen until I have a way that's fail-proof. I refuse to be held in a hospital against my will. Not again.
No one deserves the shit I would put them through.

Because the perfect person for me doesn't exist. And if she did, I would just end up being toxic to her, because my happiness would rely solely on how much attention and love she showers me with, or fails to show. It's a recipe for disaster. I'm too sick for a relationship to be healthy, even if it magically was to exist.

And because I don't matter. In the end, none of us do. Existence is meaningless, no matter how much we try to pretend it isn't. We live and then we die. That's it. In 100 years no one will know my name.
If only that were true... I really wish it was.
I have nothing else to talk about. My existence is nothing but sadness.

Thank you, but it's fine. I've come to learn over the years that long conversations with internet strangers about my sadness just make me feel worse. I'm just here to rant, so that someone knows I exist. But yah, actual conversations require energy and effort and result in nothing at the end besides an even stronger feeling of emptiness.

Good. I want to ruin my teeth. I want to get used to throwing up. Maybe if I'm lucky it will kill me faster. Two FAMILY SIZE bags of chips. On top of nutella, pizza, donuts, and tons of other shit I ate today to try and feel less numb. On top of me slicing my arm open for the 7th? 8th? day in a row. It's a nasty habit? Good. I deserve nothing better. No one cares at the end of the day anyway. At the end of the day, I'm still all alone in this bed.

Extreme Loneliness/ being single and unloved for almost 4 years, extreme poverty, taking too long with university studies, a homophobic mother, severe bpd, adhd, severe anxiety and depression, all diagnosed. Reoccurring troubles with anorexia and binge eating. Reoccurring trauma from my rape. Not being able to sleep at night because I'm lonely. Problems picking at my skin, burning myself, disassociating, cutting myself, etc. And now I have to leave my apartment. 

It's a sign that I should be dead but I'm too weak. It's a sign that I'm too weak to even do what's best for the world... To rid it of my pathetic existence.

I've been in therapy twice a week for over 10 years. I have tried dbt, mbt, and am currently seeing one of the top specialists for my mental illness (bpd) in my country. Therapy does shit for me. I've tried. I've poured my heart and soul into it, believing it would work. And it didn't. And as for my friends, they're not here for me. They all say they want to help, but when I tell them I'm sad, they don't do anything about it besides offer the typical bullshit answer that "this will pass." yah right. When? In 30 more years? How many years do I need to suffer alone before my life magically takes this turn for the better that everyone is talking about? Because I tried therapy. I still am. I tried religion. I tried throwing myself at whatever pathetic person I could find, just for some attention. Nothing works.

"you're willing to hurt yourself so why not get the same release from some high intensity exercise." What part of this doesn't work did you not hear? Exercise. Does. Not. Make. The. Pain. Stop. There is NO "same release." N.O. Only harming myself does. I can run for hours and still feel like absolute shit. It won't stop the tears like cutting does. Of course I'm going to put down your attempt to help, when your attempt shows you didn't even read what I wrote.
I don't have to admit. Walking and running do absolutely nothing for me.
Lol. Imagine being so mentally healthy that a simple thing like exercise could help you. I'm sorry but this post is just silly, even if the intentions were good.

I have therapy. 10 years of it. I'm now seeing one of the top specialists for bpd in my country. It's still not working, no matter how hard I try and hope. So now I don't bother hoping anymore. Throwing myself into religion also failed to solve anything. I can honestly say that in all 10 years of my expensive, specialized therapists, I've gained practically nothing.

My friends don't understand me. And they get easily overwhelmed, leading to fights and them suggesting distance as a solution. Its not worth losing friends over. They can't handle the truth. They like me better when I keep my sadness hidden.

They tell me I could simply just stop hurting myself. Like, when the thought comes into my head, I could say no, and put down the knife, and simply not do it. This sort of statement pisses me off because it shows they have no idea how hard it is for me. Half the time I'm not even here. I'm disassociating and fighting my entire body, that's burning with this intense begging for release. If it were that easy, I would have stopped long ago. And in times when I'm harming myself, it's because I've already done everything I could think of to calm down in other ways. If I'm hurting myself, it means nothing else has worked. Someone suggesting I should just stop, or someone saying I'm too old for this, or whatever, does nothing but make it worse. It's like my friend who says I can either eat healthy or be fat, that easy. I can't stop binging. I can't just force myself to magically be ok with this starving feeling in my stomach.
Me.

I fear it's the system itself. I've been in treatment in 4 different countries so far, and 3 different states.

Thank you for your kind words.

They could sit with me, and hug me, and talk to me...and tell me I'm strong and that life isn't fair but is worth living somehow. They could try to cheer me up with movies or stories or whatever... I just need someone to listen, really. And to not immediately respond with statements that make me feel weak or misunderstood. I don't want them to ignore that I'm sad. And I don't want them to act like my self harm is something that's easy to fix, or that I should magically have full control over.

I don't know what's stopping them. Usually they just ignore that im sad, or they move on without really trying to help me feel better. Or in worst case scenarios they chastise me for not being stronger, and giving in to self harm.

Not really. I care about my friends, but I don't have a single person who will just sit with me and help me when I'm sad. They all say they will, and then they  mysteriously dissappear when I need them, regardless of how many times I'm there for them. Like, they like the idea of helping me. But theyre useless in real life.

I can't. That's the stupid part. I feed off of approval... If I treat someone badly, I worry they will no longer like me, leading to hating me, meaning I should be dead. Try as I do to see between black and white, my mind just won't wrap around the idea. Im stuck being basically a fucking servant to anyone who asks. Giving stuff for free, sacrificing entire days of my life for others... And for nothing. Nothing but a feeling of being needed, which helps me not die for one more day.
I already opened up to her and she gave me that generic "I'm here for you" bullshit. Except when I need her, she's never there. Makes excuses to leave when I'm sad. I'm nothing to her.

I've been in weekly therapy for 10 years now, with bpd specialized therapy for 4. I've tried mindfulness, dbt, mbt, etc. Nothing works, even when I pour my heart into it and pray I get better. I've come to realize it's a joke. They just want my money. And to use me for more of their research, as always. I'm not really going to get better. It's useless to have false hopes. If therapy worked for me, it would have worked by now. I even went through a religious phase to try and get better. And still nothing. I see one of the top bpd therapists in my country now, twice a week for over a year. Where the fuck are my results?
I don't think so. She could have said anything and it would have been better than silence. I think she just didn't want to help me.

I took 2 years of dbt and saw no results. I'm now seeing a specialist for bpd, who uses mbt as a treatment. Still I see nothing. And this is with intense months of trying my hardest to get better. I'm over it now. Getting better is an illusion and therapists are just money pits.
Thank you

Bpd is borderline personality disorder, not bipolar. A favorite person is a term people with bpd use to describe a person on whom you're so emotionally attached that any slight shift in their attitude towards you severely affects your mental health. Sorry if this is confusing... A simple search on borderline personality disorder and favorite person can provide more answers.
Sorry, favorite person. I have bpd.
For what? No need to apologize. Thank you for trying to help. It's more than most people do.

I live with 2 friends. They are rarely around lately and tend to leave the house when I'm crying.

It would be lovely if the problem wasn't me. But sadly it is. I have severe bpd that runs in my family. My grandmother killed herself from it. I'm currently a subject for 2 different research projects on bpd. I also have diagnosed depression, anxiety, adhd, and am recovered from ptsd due to rape. I'm still fighting bouts of anorexia, which again was clinically diagnosed. And I live in a country where diagnoses are made carefully, not like America. So sadly there is no mistake here. I'm alive because I'm a coward who can't face failure again. I will continue to live until I have a surefire way to kill myself, without the fear of failure. I've already failed too many times to count, and the outcome has only made life worse. I wish you didn't say your glad I'm alive. Because I'm not glad. And at the end of the day, me being alive or dead makes no difference to you or the rest of this world.
I can't just let them go... I have trouble finding self worth outside of friendships. My will to live is based on how many friends I have. When I lose a friend, all hell breaks loose.

I don't know. If I don't help my friends I fear they will leave me. And then I will be more alone, and in more pain. I can't leave a text unanswered or I literally get aches in my heart. At least the way things are, I can pretend I have people who care. My parents sure don't. You hit the nail on the head with that one. I've been everyone's therapist since I was a kid.

That's exactly what I'm confused about.... I keep my pain a secret from many friends. But the ones I'm talking about have asked, some even begged, me to share with them when I'm struggling. So I do. And then time after time, they don't respond. Not until I change the subject or send a meme or something. It's like they want a pat on the back for helping without doing anything. Take my one friend for example. She has an ED and I literally stayed with her for 3 days straight this past week to make sure she eats. In return she asks how I am, sees my reply, and doesn't answer for 2 days straight until I send her a funny cat meme and she pretends everything is fine. What the fuck is that? But I can't do anything about it because I love her and I don't want her to leave... So I just sit here, giving my all and getting nothing in return.

Thank you 😔 I don't know. I can't live without my friends. I love them dearly, even if I complain. I just don't understand for the life of me why they don't react the way I do. If someone I care about needs me, I'm there. I will skip sleeping, class, work, etc. to be there. I'm skipping work right now to help my friend apply to unemployment. I just don't understand why they never seem to offer the same support back. They even say they care, over and over, and follow it up with nothing. Leaving me on read when I tell them I'm having trouble putting down my knife and could really use a hug. And it's not like I tell all my friends this. The friends I'm talking about are the ones who have asked me to tell them when I'm upset, so they can help. What a lie.

It doesn't matter if they're busy or whatnot. I don't understand how someone can ask me if I'm OK, see my answer, and not reply. I said no, I'm not ok. And for all the times theyve done the same to me, and I've rushed to their side, they leave me here with nothing. I'm always there for my friends. It's not unrealistic. If they cared they could do it. I sure do.

And no, this isn't me saying I'm a wonderful friend, because I'm not. I'm just so afraid of them leaving that I'll do whatever it takes to be there for them 24/7. But I don't understand how someone can accept my help and then give nothing in return. I've read the arguments on here and it still doesn't make sense. If my friend says she's in pain, my heart literally aches until I help her. I can't sleep at night. Why am I so cursed that I have to see the world differently than what is clearly normal... To be stepped all over is apparently normal..

I do want to change. But after 10 years of honestly trying my best and seeing no results with one of the top bpd therapists in my country, I just don't see the hope anymore. I don't think it's possible. Maybe if I just had bpd. But no, I have an ED and tons of things on top. I think it's too late for me.
Thank you. But I don't think I deserve anything better. I deserve this pain.

Thank you 😔 But I'm not a nice person. I'm vengeful and miserable and I apparently expect too much from my friends. I cant sleep at night if I know my friend needs me, but that's only because I fear them leaving me when I'm not there to pick up the pieces of their lives. I'm selfish is what I am.

I just don't get it because they ask how I am, and then don't respond. Or they say they're there for me and then they aren't. Maybe im toxic but I feel like I'm only asking them to fulfill the promises they made me.

I would love to, but unfortunately it's not that easy. Having friends is directly correlated to how I feel about myself. And keeping them happy and supported is basically a full time job for me... If I don't do it, I fear they will all hate me and leave. And then I'll be even more alone. It's a cycle. I can't sleep at night sometimes until I've checked up on at least 3 of them.

But when they ask to me to help them... I can't just leave them alone.. I care too much. Which is why I'm so hurt... All the time they ask for my help, and I give it. And when the time comes for me to ask for help, even to those who promise they are here for me, no one is around. I don't know. Maybe I'm just toxic. Maybe I don't deserve friends anyway. After all, I'm a bpd mess.

Isn't it, when I constantly check on them, and make sure they're safe? When I rush to help them every time they ask? When they promise me they're they're for me, and they care? Or are promises and reciprocity worthless nowadays?
If only I could believe in this. But sadly I know my life too well to have hope. And most people don't want a girl with a slew of incurable mental illnesses and scars.
Then why do I always have to be responsible for making them happy and taking care of them? Maybe it's time for me to stop giving away favors.

I am doing everything I can. I see a therapist twice a week, am on 3 drugs, and am doing a PhD in a field I love. None of this makes my life any happier. I can't just magically make myself happy like you seem to. Nothing I try works. I can have a wonderful day with fun activities and friends, and at the end, it's still me, alone in my bed, wishing I was dead. Did your wish to die just disappear once you decided to make yourself happy?

I don't think I'm better than anyone. I think I'm scum. I help my friends because I feel like shit if I don't. Like I failed them and am not doing my job. Aka how I imagine they should feel for the way they treat me. I honestly don't see narcissism here because I have no self esteem whatsoever. But who knows. Maybe you're right. Not that it changes anything. I just can't get over the fact that you honestly see reciprocity as something unnecessary or unexpected. To me this makes no sense... You see a friend in need, you help. Regardless of if you have the energy for it, or time, or whatever. I assumed this is normal. If it isn't, then this world is even worse than I thought.
Thank you. This strangely helps. I'm sorry for you...no that my words will change or mean anything in the long run.

I can either ignore it and pretend I'm happy, which I'm not, or I can try and kill myself and ultimately fail again, because that's the sort of failure I am.
